purpose: Initial structured-routing judgments over checked-in public draft product metadata; no production changes

candidates.route_summary: Prepare DynamoDB API requests for agent session state, optional status index, item expiration, point in time recovery and change streams.
candidates.supported_boundary: Offline request planning for a new DynamoDB agent/session table using string keys, on-demand billing and AWS managed KMS, with separately selected status index, TTL, recovery and streams. No AWS execution, response matcher, existing-table migration, IAM provisioning, global tables, customer-managed KMS or immediate TTL deletion.

candidates.route_summary: Configure Python Lambda Powertools DynamoDB idempotency to deduplicate completed retries, reject changed payment payloads and reason about uncertain external side effects.
candidates.supported_boundary: Guidance and tested Python 3.12/Powertools 3.36.0 wiring for a single decoded JSON payment event per Lambda invocation and an existing DynamoDB persistence table. Requires a buyer-supplied payment function with durable downstream idempotency. Does not implement a payment processor, cross-service atomicity, authentication, SQS batch handling, AWS deployment or other language adapters.

requests.goal: Repeated queue deliveries keep applying the same side effect. I need the Lambda operation to happen once even when the event returns.
The record that decides whether a job can progress should only change when its saved revision still matches. Stale changes must be rejected.
Split overloaded database partitions and redesign the partition key so our table stops throttling.
